build_activation: build a PyTorch activation module from an Activation enum like ReLU, GeLU, or SquaredReLU
get_linear: build a linear layer with optional activation and dropout for a neural network
get_feedforward: build a feedforward network with configurable hidden layer multiplier and activation function
no_weight_decay: get a set of parameter names to exclude from weight decay in an optimizer
get_normalization_layer: build a normalization layer from a NormalizationType enum like LayerNorm, RMSNorm, or Skip
